asmc.observation: Dry weather persisted over the southern ASEAN region today, apart from the northern and central parts of Sumatra, parts of Peninsular Malaysia and the northern parts of Borneo where there were showers. Widespread hotspots were detected in Kalimantan and Sumatra, while few hotspots were detected in Sarawak. Moderate to dense smoke haze was observed over parts of Kalimantan, Sumatra, Sulawesi and Papua. Several quality stations in southern and eastern Kalimantan as well as southern and central Sumatra reported Unhealthy to Hazardous levels. The full extent of the hotspot situation over Kalimantan and Sumatra could not be determined due to obscuration by thick smoke haze and cloud cover, while the smoke haze situation over parts of the region could not be fully determined due to cloud cover. Wet weather was observed over the Mekong sub-region, except over the northeastern and central parts of the Mekong sub-region where it was relatively drier. Few hotspots were detected in the Mekong sub-region, but not significant smoke plumes were observed.
